name: Daniel Bodi Gil
headline: Design Engineer & Design System Lead
specialism: AI-first design systems | Tokens, Storybook and CI | 15+ years across product design and front-end
summary: Design engineer and design-system lead. I build design systems end to end, from research and Figma foundations to tokens, Storybook, CI and the AI tooling that helps teams adopt them. Most recently led Plectrum, an AI-first design system built for 100+ developers at Solidaris; before that, built Bridgestone FleetBridge's design system from zero, without a mandate.
competencies: Design-system strategy and governance | Design tokens (Figma to code) | Storybook | Figma | Angular / TypeScript | React (Storybook, portfolio) | SCSS, ITCSS / BEM | PrimeNG theming | CI quality gates | AI agents and MCP | Developer tooling | UX research and prototyping | Accessibility (WCAG AA) | Coaching and design reviews
employer_note: Senior UX Engineer at Cegeka (formerly CTG) since January 2019, embedded in client teams as their design-system and product-design lead.

page_one_roles.intro: Sole design-system engineer for Plectrum, the AI-first design system for Solidaris' application teams across Belgium (100+ developers), alongside product design for case-management apps.
bullets: Led Plectrum's strategy, architecture and delivery end to end: 21 components on top of PrimeNG and 19 foundation pages in a versioned Storybook, piloted with 3 teams on 2 prototype apps, release 2.1.0 shipped ahead of the teams' redesigns.
Shipped an AI agent and a versioned MCP server that recommend which components to reuse or compose, so developers and coding agents work from the same source as Storybook.
Redesigned governance after stakeholder pushback: replaced a central approval gate with local-first contribution, plus usage reports and a dashboard that show the core team what to promote.
Built the Figma-to-code token pipeline in both directions with designer review, made compiled CSS the source of truth, and added CI gates for token drift, API/docs alignment and accessibility.
Built a developer toolkit that installs the system, its checks and agent instructions into any Angular application, with safe upgrades.
Led product research, workshops and prototype testing for case-management apps; handed over with a starter app, runbooks and documentation.

page_one_roles.intro: FleetBridge, Bridgestone's fleet and tyre operations platform, used across several European countries. Joined as sole designer; designed the web back office that progressively replaced FleetBridge mobile.
bullets: Built the FleetBridge design system from zero, without an initial mandate: 40+ documented components adopted by 15+ developers, who estimated ~60% faster UI feature delivery.
Secured dedicated design-system funding that stakeholders had declined, by shipping shared patterns until the value showed in the product.
Grew design from one to three designers; introduced design reviews, reviewed pull requests and coached developers on CSS architecture and component use.
Made production CSS the single source for Storybook documentation (ITCSS/BEM, two themes).

page_two_roles.intro: Led end-to-end design of the QC1 interface for a radiopharmaceutical quality-control device, a safety-critical domain.
bullets: Designed realistic device visualisations for valves, columns, injectors and schedules, matching technicians' physical mental model.
Designed for visual impairment from the start: status carried by pattern, text and hierarchy as well as colour.
Task-based testing reported 85% task success; prototyping became about three times faster once the component approach was in place.
Set up Nx/Angular, ITCSS/BEM and Storybook foundations, then coached the internal developer who took over the front end.

page_two_roles.intro: Modernised front-end foundations and design workflows for enterprise banking software.
bullets: Introduced BEM and replaced Bootstrap 3's float-based layout with a custom Flexbox grid, reducing UI technical debt.
Started a design-system direction combining documentation, reusable components and hands-on coaching for a junior front-end team.

page_two_roles.intro: Delivered responsive, cross-browser UI for high-traffic telecom sites and applications in Adobe Experience Manager.
bullets: Built reusable interface components and introduced BEM to improve CSS structure across Base and Telenet work.
Added npm tooling and automatic reload workflows that removed manual compile cycles from front-end changes.

education: Higher education in Web Design & Development (short-cycle, with distinction) - Format 21, La Louviere | 2009 - 2010
